text.A: **तपाईं जहाँसुकै हुनुहुन्छ, यो नीति लागू हुन्छ।** हामी बेलायतको डेटा संरक्षण कानुन पालना गर्छौँ, र तपाईं बस्ने देशको डेटा संरक्षण कानुन पनि लागू हुने अवस्थामा, हामी त्यो पनि पालना गर्छौँ।
text.B: **एलर्जी र आहारसम्बन्धी नोटहरू।** हामी तिनलाई तपाईंको अर्डरसँगै ट्रकलाई पठाउँछौँ र अरू कुनै काममा प्रयोग गर्दैनौँ। अर्डर गरेको 12 महिनापछि हामी तिनलाई तपाईंको नाम र सम्पर्क विवरणसहित हटाउँछौँ (खण्ड 7 हेर्नुहोस्)।
text.C: **अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय स्थानान्तरण।** तपाईंको खाताको डेटा र अर्डरको डेटा बेलायतमा भण्डारण र प्रशोधन गरिन्छ। केही कुरा बेलायतबाहिर सम्हालिन्छन्: मेनुबाट सामग्री निकाल्ने काम र WhatsApp का स्वचालित जवाफहरू, जसले संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकामा रहेको Google को सेवा प्रयोग गर्छन्; WhatsApp सन्देश पुर्‍याउने काम, जुन संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकामा Meta ले सम्हाल्छ; भुक्तानीहरू, जुन संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकामा Stripe ले सम्हाल्छ; र पुस नोटिफिकेसनहरू, जुन संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकामा Apple र Google ले पुर्‍याउँछन्। डेटा बेलायतबाहिर जाँदा, त्यो स्थानान्तरण बेलायतका पर्याप्तता नियमहरू (UK adequacy regulations) वा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय डेटा स्थानान्तरण सम्झौता (International Data Transfer Agreement) वा परिशिष्ट (Addendum) अन्तर्गत पर्छ, र तपाईंको देशको कानुनले आवश्यक पारेको अवस्थामा, त्यो कानुनले मान्यता दिएको सुरक्षा उपायअन्तर्गत पनि पर्छ। लागू हुने सुरक्षा उपायहरूको विवरण तपाईं हामीसँग माग्न सक्नुहुन्छ।
text.G:
हाम्रा [सेवाका सर्तहरू](/terms) HatchGrab प्रयोग हुने हरेक देशमा लागू हुन्छन्। केही देशमा थप नियमहरू छन्। यो पृष्ठले तिनलाई एक-एक देश गरेर प्रस्तुत गर्छ।

तलको कुनै खण्ड तपाईंमा लागू हुन्छ भने, त्यो हाम्रा सेवाका सर्तहरूको अंश हुन्छ। त्यसले तिनीभन्दा फरक कुरा भन्छ भने, त्यस देशका लागि यही पृष्ठ लागू हुन्छ।

तपाईंको देश सूचीमा छैन भने, कुनै थप नियम छैन: सेवाका सर्तहरू लेखिएअनुसार नै लागू हुन्छन्। हाम्रो [गोपनीयता नीति](/privacy) हरेक देशमा एउटै हो।

back.A: **Wherever you are, this policy applies.** We comply with the UK's data protection law, and where the data protection law of the country you live in also applies, we comply with that too.
back.B: **Allergy and diet-related notes.** We send them to the truck together with your order and do not use them for any other work. 12 months after the order we remove them together with your name and contact details (see section 7).
back.C: When data goes outside the UK, the transfer falls under the UK adequacy regulations or the International Data Transfer Agreement or the Addendum, and, where the law of your country requires it, also under a safeguard recognised by that law.
back.D: ## 8. Your rights / Under the UK's data protection law, and where applicable the law of the country you live in, you have the following rights: [7 bullets unchanged] / The law of the place where you live may give you these rights under other names, or additional rights. You have those rights too. / **Making a request.** Email privacy@hatchgrab.com. Before taking action we will check whether the request is genuine. You can ask someone else to make the request on your behalf, and we will not treat you differently just because you made a request. We will reply within one month, or sooner than that if the law of your country requires it. If you ordered from a truck, we may send your request to that truck, because it is the one that decides how your order details are used. If we refuse a request, you can ask us to look at it again by replying to our answer. / **Deleting your account.** [old text unchanged] When an operator's account is deleted, we also remove their customers' names, contact details and notes from the orders we keep. / **Marketing emails.** We send marketing emails only where the law of the country you live in allows it, which in some countries means only with your consent. Every email says who it is from, contains our postal address, and tells you how to stop receiving them. If you ask us to stop, we will stop free of charge and within 10 working days. Emails about an order or your account are not marketing. If we or a truck give order updates by text message, you will get them only if you consent, and you can stop them at any time. / **If something goes wrong.** If a breach involving your personal data is likely to cause you serious harm, where the law requires it we will inform you and the regulatory body as soon as we can, or help the truck you ordered from to do so. / **Complaints.** First tell us at privacy@hatchgrab.com; we would be grateful if you gave us the chance to put things right. You can also complain to the data protection regulatory body of the country you live in. In the UK, that is the Information Commissioner's Office (Information Commissioner's Office), via ico.org.uk or by phoning 0303 123 1113.
back.G: Our [Terms of Service] apply in every country where HatchGrab is used. Some countries have additional rules.
